title: Blue Mountain Beach "Liberty Hill Cottage" 11 Lanier Ln
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "Liberty Hill Cottage" 11 Lanier Ln
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 6-seater Low-Speed Vehicle- 1 home away from Community pool and clubhouse- Walking paths- Community pool Heated (March to May)- Beautiful Lake- 5 adult bikes- Catch and release by the lake- Gas-burning fireplace by the clubhouse- Outdoor grill and kitchen by the clubhouse- Ping pong table by the clubhouse - Outdoor shower by the clubhouse - Grill in backyard - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Liberty Hill Cottage, formally known as Gibson Getaway, is the perfect spot for a beach vacation. Located in the beautiful Blue Mountain Beach community, this 3-story home sleeps up to 10 people with five bedrooms and 5.5 baths. Just a 3-minute drive from Gulfview Heights Public Beach, you and your guests can spend plenty of time in the surf and sun.You'll be in awe of this Gulf Coast home when you ascend the front porch stairs and enter through the double doors. The spacious layout on the first floor marries the living, dining, and kitchen areas together—making it the ideal place to entertain. Lounge on the sectional couch or armchair before gathering around the 8-seat dining room table for dinner. The extravagant chef's kitchen will make cooking fun as this communal space sits four at the bar and has top-of-the-line appliances, including a wine fridge. There is also one guest bedroom located on this floor for convenience.On the second floor, you'll find two additional guest bedrooms with queen-sized beds and one primary suite with a king bed—all feature private bathrooms. As you venture down the hallway, you'll find another bathroom and a laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer.The top floor bedroom has some of the best amenities—a king bed, private bathroom, TV, and a spacious sitting area with a desk. The room offers exclusive access to an outdoor balcony overlooking the pristine Gulf Coast. Relax and de-stress from the comfort of your room!If you're looking for an outdoor adventure, head to the community pool or nearby lake on the five adult bikes. The Community clubhouse features an outdoor wood-burning fireplace, an Outdoor grill & kitchen area, and a ping pong table to keep the kids distracted or take a stroll on the walking pathway throughout the neighborhood. Chill by the lake or enjoy a day of catch and release. The Beach access is at Gulf View Heights. It's a 3-minute car or golf cart ride, a 4-minute bike ride on the bike path, and a 10 - 15-minute walk on the walking path. Book now and enjoy the walking paths, pavilion, playground, and beautiful lake!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only SECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only

body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Blue Mountain Beach "Liberty Hill Cottage" 11 Lanier Ln Santa Rosa Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-102346 Bedrooms 5 Beds 5 Sleeps 10 Full Baths 5 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 6-seater Low-Speed Vehicle - 1 home away from Community pool and clubhouse - Walking paths - Community pool Heated (March to May) - Beautiful Lake - 5 adult bikes - Catch and release by the lake - Gas-burning fireplace by the clubhouse - Outdoor grill and kitchen by the clubhouse - Ping pong table by the clubhouse - Outdoor shower by the clubhouse - Grill in backyard - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Liberty Hill Cottage, formally known as Gibson Getaway, is the perfect spot for a beach vacation. Located in the beautiful Blue Mountain Beach community, this 3-story home sleeps up to 10 people with five bedrooms and 5.5 baths. Just a 3-minute drive from Gulfview Heights Public Beach, you and your guests can spend plenty of time in the surf and sun. You'll be in awe of this Gulf Coast home when you ascend the front porch stairs and enter through the double doors. The spacious layout on the first floor marries the living, dining, and kitchen areas together—making it the ideal place to entertain. Lounge on the sectional couch or armchair before gathering around the 8-seat dining room table for dinner. The extravagant chef's kitchen will make cooking fun as this communal space sits four at the bar and has top-of-the-line appliances, including a wine fridge. There is also one guest bedroom located on this floor for convenience. On the second floor, you'll find two additional guest bedrooms with queen-sized beds and one primary suite with a king bed—all feature private bathrooms. As you venture down the hallway, you'll find another bathroom and a laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer. The top floor bedroom has some of the best amenities—a king bed, private bathroom, TV, and a spacious sitting area with a desk. The room offers exclusive access to an outdoor balcony overlooking the pristine Gulf Coast. Relax and de-stress from the comfort of your room! If you're looking for an outdoor adventure, head to the community pool or nearby lake on the five adult bikes. The Community clubhouse features an outdoor wood-burning fireplace, an Outdoor grill & kitchen area, and a ping pong table to keep the kids distracted or take a stroll on the walking pathway throughout the neighborhood. Chill by the lake or enjoy a day of catch and release. The Beach access is at Gulf View Heights. It's a 3-minute car or golf cart ride, a 4-minute bike ride on the bike path, and a 10 - 15-minute walk on the walking path. Book now and enjoy the walking paths, pavilion, playground, and beautiful lake!
